raw_response: {"translations":[{"id":"T0061","english":"If you need to observe the relationship between the object and the desk lamp, first ensure the target object is in hand or nearby, then execute `use desklamp` to turn on the desk lamp, rather than `examine X with desklamp`."},{"id":"T0062","english":"The desk lamp is an object fixed on a desk or side table, not a navigable location; executing `go to desklamp 1` will return \"Nothing happens\"; you should directly use `use desklamp` at the current location of the desk lamp."},{"id":"T0063","english":"In ALFWorld, only furniture and containers can be navigation targets; small objects such as desk lamps cannot be targets for go to."},{"id":"T0064","english":"When already at the furniture location where the desk lamp is, directly execute `use desklamp`; do not attempt `go to desklamp`."},{"id":"T0065","english":"The desk lamp is a fixed object and cannot be picked up; executing `take desklamp 1` will return \"Nothing happens\"; instead, bring the target object to the desk lamp or directly use the desk lamp."},{"id":"T0066","english":"In ALFWorld, desk lamps are marked as fixed objects and cannot be carried."},{"id":"T0067","english":"Do not attempt to pick up the desk lamp; if the target object is carryable, pick up the target object and move to the location of the desk lamp, then use the desk lamp."},{"id":"T0068","english":"Dual-item placement: first take the first item and temporarily store it, then take the second item and perform the final placement."},{"id":"T0069","english":"In dual-item placement tasks, if only one item can be carried at a time, first find and pick up the first target item, temporarily store it in the target container or a temporary container, then find and pick up the second target item, and finally put both items into the target container."},{"id":"T0070","english":"When the task requires putting two items of the same type into the same target container, and the environment restricts carrying to one item at a time."},{"id":"T0071","english":"In dual-item placement tasks, if you already hold one item, directly attempting to take the second item of the same type usually fails and returns \"Nothing happens\"."},{"id":"T0072","english":"The environment restricts carrying to one item at a time, so you must first put down or temporarily store the current item before you can take the second item."},{"id":"T0073","english":"Before taking the second item, first put the first item into the target container or a temporary container to ensure the inventory is empty."},{"id":"T0074","english":"In dual-item placement tasks, putting an item into a non-target container such as garbagecan may cause it to be irretrievable later or cause the task to fail."},{"id":"T0075","english":"Some containers may not accept items, or the item's state may change after being put in, making it impossible to continue completing the task."}]}
